Just Plain English

JPE Core Reference

Welcome to JPE Studio

JPE stands for Just Plain English – a simple, readable syntax for creating The Sims 4 mods without complex XML or programming knowledge. Instead of fighting with tags, you write sentences that describe what your mod does.

Why use JPE?

JPE is designed to be Human-Readable, Beginner-Friendly, and Industrial-Scale Ready. It minimizes errors by using a clear, hierarchical structure (indentation) and plain English keywords.

Your First Mod

Create a .jpe file and define an interaction. For example:

My First Interaction
  description: "Hello World"
  tests:
    - actor is adult

Build it (Ctrl+B) and JPE Studio handles the rest.

JPE Snippet
My First Interaction
  description: "Hello World"
  tests:
    - actor is adult
